app.name: OpenLess
app.one_liner: An open-source voice input app for macOS and Windows that captures speech via hotkey and outputs AI-polished text at the cursor.

screens.name: Main Voice Input Interface
screens.purpose: Display recording state and provide visual feedback during dictation.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configure hotkeys, AI preferences, and update channel.

rust_commands.name: inject_text_at_cursor
rust_commands.purpose: Insert AI-polished text at the system cursor location.

rust_commands.name: trigger_recording
rust_commands.purpose: Initiate audio capture either via hotkey or CLI fallback (e.g., for Wayland).

mvp_plan: week 1: Build basic Tauri window for recording feedback
week 1: Implement hotkey listener for macOS/Windows
week 1: Integrate CLI fallback for Linux/Wayland
acceptance_tests: On Debian/Wayland, CLI-triggered recording works as fallback when hotkey fails.
On macOS, after installing via DMG and running 'xattr -cr', the app launches without Gatekeeper error.
Pressing the global hotkey starts recording and inserts AI-polished text at cursor upon release.
Switching to Beta channel in Settings makes pre-release versions visible in updater.
